Fama and French market against the S&P 500 price index

cmd.WTI.description: WTI crude oil, USD per barrel

cmd.BRENT.description: Brent crude oil, USD per barrel

eq.US_TOTAL.description: Benchmark: Fama and French US market total return, extended to the latest day with S&P 500 price returns plus the recent dividend yield. See DEC-0008.

eq.SPY.description: SPY ETF, adjusted close; cross-check only, not used in results (Yahoo's terms do not allow automated collection)

runs.description: Owns high interest rate currencies and borrows in low rate ones.
runs.summary: Long the 3 highest-rate G10 currencies, short the 3 lowest, rebalance monthly.

gauntlet.verdict: Some signs of a real effect, not enough to rely on.

tests.name: Better return for the risk
tests.plain: Does it earn more per unit of bumpiness than just holding the S&P 500?
tests.bar: Sharpe above the S&P 500's

tests.name: More money at the same risk
tests.plain: If we turn it up until it is exactly as bumpy as stocks, and pay for any borrowing, does it make more money?
tests.bar: Yearly return above the market's at the market's own volatility

tests.name: Not just the best of many tries
tests.plain: We tried 102 ideas. Is this one good even after allowing for the fact that one of them was bound to look good by luck?
tests.bar: Deflated Sharpe of 0.95 or more

tests.name: Survives double trading costs
tests.plain: If trading costs twice what we guessed, does it still beat the S&P 500?
tests.bar: Sharpe above the S&P 500's at 2x costs

tests.name: Wins in every era
tests.plain: Does it beat the S&P 500 in each of three very different periods, not just on average?
tests.bar: Sharpe above the S&P 500's in every period

tests.name: Wins on the most recent years
tests.plain: Markets change. Does it beat the S&P 500 over the last 5 years alone?
tests.bar: Sharpe above the S&P 500's since 2021-10-20

tests.name: Clearly above zero
tests.plain: If history had been shuffled a little, would it still have made money? We replay 1,000 jumbled versions of the past and look at the range.
tests.bar: The whole 95% range of Sharpe is above zero

tests.name: Timing matters
tests.plain: If we keep the same bets but place them on random dates, does it do much worse? If not, the signal is not telling us anything.
tests.bar: Beaten by fewer than 5% of random-date copies

tests.name: Not one lucky setting
tests.plain: If we nudge its settings a bit, does it still make money? A real effect should not depend on picking exactly the right number.
tests.bar: At least 75% of nearby settings have a positive Sharpe

tests.name: Not one lucky year
tests.plain: If we delete its single best year, is it still positive?
tests.bar: Sharpe above zero without the best year

tests.name: Does not crash with stocks
tests.plain: In the worst months for the stock market, does it lose money too?
tests.value: -1.0% average in the S&P 500's worst 5% of months
tests.bar: Zero or positive on average in the S&P 500's worst months
